title: will i too
description: a modpack with a bunch of cool mods
body:
will i too is a Vanilla+ Forge 1.20.4 modpack built around curiosity, exploration, and the quiet question of what’s over there?

It doesn’t try to overwhelm you with tech trees or endless menus. Instead, it adds beautiful terrain, meaningful exploration, better food, and smart quality-of-life improvements that make the world feel deeper without losing Minecraft’s soul.

🌍 A World That Pulls You Forward

Vast, varied terrain powered by Terralith

New dungeons, taverns, and structures that reward exploration

Bounty boards that give purpose to wandering

Backpacks that make long journeys actually viable

🍲 Survival That Feels Alive

Hundreds of new meals from Pam’s HarvestCraft 2

Cooking is more than survival — it’s progression

Fun food additions like golden foods for powerful rewards

🛠 Quiet but Powerful Improvements

JEI for clean, simple recipe viewing

Performance boosts with FerriteCore and Entity Culling

Freecam for scouting, planning, or cinematic views

Cleaner progression and smoother overall gameplay

🎥 For Players Who Like the Little Moments

ReplayMod for capturing builds, journeys, and memories

A calm, polished experience that shines in both singleplayer and small servers

🎯 Who This Pack Is For

Players who like to wander first, optimize later

Builders who want terrain worth building in

Survival players who enjoy depth without complexity

Anyone asking the question: will I too?
